items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I heard of him, but that's been nice, a good while now.

ctx.x: Did you ever know two guys, they called themselves Jack and Jill? Uh... Jack Dowden, he played mandolin. And Jules Batiste, he played guitar?

Oh, Jules Batiste. I heard of him, but that's been nice, a good while now. Yeah. Johnny St. Cyr used to play with him. Johnny St. Cyr was, uh... Was a guitar player too. A fine guitar player too. Yeah. Johnny St. Cyr was... Well, he complimented. He played with Brobyshire's band too, used to... He played with all them, uh... all them big high bands.
